videoTitle: You Don't Need 4 Gym Days a Week to Build Muscle—Here's What Actually Works
videoDescription: Turns out the CDC recommends something very different for people managing packed schedules and chronic health conditions. The real barrier isn't motivation—it's building a system that fits your actual capacity. Find the full breakdown at mindtivate.com
script: You've been told you need four strength sessions a week to see results. But the CDC actually recommends just two days of muscle-strengthening for adults with chronic conditions—and two or three well-structured sessions will build muscle and support fat loss, especially when...
Visit mindtivate.com to find the answer.
